paper_metadata.title: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence
paper_metadata.abstract:
We introduce Kimi K2, a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language model with 32 billion activated parameters and 1 trillion total parameters. We propose the MuonClip optimizer, which improves upon Muon with a novel QK-clip technique to address training instability while enjoying the advanced token efficiency of Muon. Based on MuonClip, K2 was pre-trained on 15.5 trillion tokens with zero loss spike. During post-training, K2 undergoes a multi-stage post-training process, highlighted by a large-scale agentic data synthesis pipeline and a joint reinforcement learning (RL) stage, where the model improves its capabilities through interactions with real and synthetic environments.
  Kimi K2 achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source non-thinking models, with strengths in agentic capabilities. Notably, K2 obtains 66.1 on Tau2-Bench, 76.5 on ACEBench (En), 65.8 on SWE-Bench Verified, and 47.3 on SWE-Bench Multilingual -- surpassing most open and closed-sourced baselines in non-thinking settings. It also exhibits strong capabilities in coding, mathematics, and reasoning tasks, with a score of 53.7 on LiveCodeBench v6, 49.5 on AIME 2025, 75.1 on GPQA-Diamond, and 27.1 on OJBench, all without extended thinking. These results position Kimi K2 as one of the most capable open-source large language models to date, particularly in software engineering and agentic tasks. We release our base and post-trained model checkpoints to facilitate future research and applications of agentic intelligence.

extraction_data.innovation: MuonClip optimizer (integrates Muon with QK-Clip weight clipping to prevent exploding attention logits and ensure stable training); large-scale agentic data synthesis pipeline generating tool-use demonstrations via simulated/real environments; joint reinforcement learning framework combining verifiable rewards (RLVR) with a self-critique rubric reward mechanism for open-ended alignment.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: 15.5T high-quality tokens spanning Web Text, Code, Mathematics, Knowledge; rephrasing-based synthetic augmentation
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by joint reinforcement learning (RLVR + self-critique rubric reward), Supervised fine-tuning (SFT)
extraction_data.extension: Sparsity scaling law tailored for MoE models; increasing sparsity (384 experts) reduces FLOPs by up to 1.69x compared to sparsity 8 while maintaining validation loss.
extraction_data.research_problem: Agentic intelligence and token-efficient scaling of large language models
extraction_data.application: Agentic tasks, software engineering, coding, mathematics, reasoning
extraction_data.finetuning_data: Human-annotated preference data; synthetic agentic trajectories; tool-use and coding datasets, Large-scale instruction-tuning dataset spanning diverse domains; agentic data synthesized via tool spec, agent/task, and trajectory generation pipelines.
extraction_data.hardware_description: H800 cluster; nodes with 2TB RAM + 8 GPUs via NVLink/NVSwitch; 8x400 Gbps RoCE inter-node; node counts in multiples of 32
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Pretraining (WSD schedule, 15.5T); annealing; long-context activation; SFT; joint RL (RLVR + self-critique rubric reward)
extraction_data.quantization_precision: BF16 params, FP32 gradient buffers; FP8-E4M3 storage for MoE up-projection/SwiGLU activations (not compute), BF16 parameters, FP32 gradient buffers, FP8-E4M3 storage for insensitive activations
extraction_data.synthetic_data_generation_method: Chunk-wise autoregressive rephrasing (knowledge), learning-note rewriting (math), three-stage agentic pipeline: tool spec, agent/task, trajectory generation with LLM judge filtering, Large-scale agentic data synthesis pipeline generating tool-use demonstrations via simulated and real-world environments
extraction_data.rl_algorithm: Joint reinforcement learning (RL), Joint reinforcement learning (RLVR + self-critique rubric reward)
extraction_data.reward_mechanism: Verifiable rewards (RLVR) + Self-Critique Rubric Reward with core/prescriptive/human-annotated rubrics; closed-loop critic refinement, Verifiable rule-based rewards (RLVR) combined with a self-critique rubric reward mechanism
extraction_data.tool_calling_format: Custom token template: tool_declare / tool_call_section with TypeScript (and JSON) tool declarations; constrained decoding enforcer
extraction_data.training_environment_scale: Kubernetes sandbox infrastructure supporting 10,000+ concurrent instances
extraction_data.safety_evaluation_protocol: Promptfoo automated red-teaming (Harmful, Criminal, Misinformation, Privacy, Security plugins x Basic, Base64, Prompt Injection, Iterative Jailbreak, Crescendo) with human review
extraction_data.base_model: Kimi-K2-Base (trained from scratch); builds on K1.5 methodology
extraction_data.optimizer_innovation: MuonClip — improves the Muon optimizer with a novel QK-clip technique to address training instability while retaining Muon's token efficiency
extraction_data.benchmark_result: Tau2-Bench: 66.1; ACEBench (En): 76.5; SWE-Bench Verified: 65.8; SWE-Bench Multilingual: 47.3; LiveCodeBench v6: 53.7; AIME 2025: 49.5; GPQA-Diamond: 75.1; OJBench: 27.1
extraction_data.post_training_infrastructure: Hybrid colocated train/inference architecture; distributed checkpoint engine (<30s full 1T param update); Gym-like RL framework; partial rollout for long-horizon agentic tasks
